brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Build has two levels: pieces at level 0 (0,0,0; 1,0,0; 0,1,0; -1,0,0) and level 1 (0,0,1). Tower form present but no storage fittings (bins/covers) yet.

No drawer sockets available. Drawers require a half base cut face with specific adjacency; configurator offers 0 drawer placements on current layout. No drawer parts installed.

finish.summary: Built a two-level base frame but could not satisfy the two-drawer requirement – drawer sockets never became available in this configuration. Tower lacks finished storage.
